nodes.summary: Every finite game, with finitely many players, each having a finite nonempty set of pure strategies, has a mixed Nash equilibrium.
nodes.title: Nash's theorem

nodes.summary: In a finite game with players $I$, finite strategy sets $S_i$ and payoffs $u_i : \prod_j S_j \to \mathbb R$, let each player $j$ play a mixed strategy $\sigma_j$, a probability vector on $S_j$, independently of the others. The expected payoff of player $i$ is
nodes.title: Expected payoff of a mixed profile

nodes.summary: A profile $\sigma = (\sigma_j)_j$ of mixed strategies is a Nash equilibrium (Nash's equilibrium point) if no player can raise its expected payoff by switching to another mixed strategy while the others keep theirs: $U_i(\tau, \sigma_{-i}) \le U_i(\sigma)$ for every player $i$ and every mixed strategy $\tau$ of $i$.
nodes.title: Mixed Nash equilibrium

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
